symptom: Timeouts persist after a v3-only flag was set
root_cause: v3 mitigation (llm.failover.enabled) is not available on v2; the real cause is provider latency above platform.http.timeout_ms.
fix: Raise platform.http.timeout_ms; recommend upgrade to v3 for failover.
detection_tip: Check the flag exists for the customer's version in config_flags before recommending it.
